verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents an LLM Playground for testing prompts interactively. It sits inside a prompt-management workflow where prompts are iterated in the UI, and new prompt versions can be tested against datasets via Experiments. The evidence covers the playground only with a brief mention, so how it runs against real models and fills in variables is implied rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of variable substitution in the playground, details on supported model providers/real model calls, independent hands-on corroboration of playground use.
